اصطدت (form VIII)

# اِصْطَدْتَ (iṣṭadta) /isˤ.tˤad.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِصْطَادَ (iṣṭāda)
# اِصْطَدْتِ (iṣṭadti) /isˤ.tˤad.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِصْطَادَ (iṣṭāda)
# اُصْطِدْتُ (uṣṭidtu) /usˤ.tˤid.tu/: first-person singular past passive of اِص
